title: Cost Ops Experimentation Hub: initiative tracker for batching, caching, and quantization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Initiative to centralize, prioritize, and track a portfolio of controlled experiments aimed at reducing unit inference cost across Redwood hosted and dedicated products. Focus areas are: (1) continuous-batching policy tuning for latency-sensitive routes, (2) KV/prefix caching pilots for high-reuse workloads, and (3) model quantization matrix experiments (8-bit/4-bit) with fidelity gating. This tracker captures milestones, experiment matrix, ownership, success criteria, and postmortem actions to operationalize any repeatable savings into the Optimize recommendations engine.
updates: 2025-01-10 - Kickoff: charter approved by Director of Product. Created experiment matrix and prioritized 12 candidate workloads (chat, embeddings batch, rerank).

2025-01-23 - Engineering capacity confirmed for January sprint (2 engineers). Scoped canary for batching policy by route. Linked runtime feature flag (batching-v2) to the experiment. See GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1427

2025-02-05 - Baseline metrics collected for top-5 customers: median latency, 95th latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1M-tokens. Baseline dashboard created: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/cost-ops/pm-22119

2025-02-18 - Early batching results: 12% token-cost reduction at 200ms tail latency increase on non-real-time routes. Product decision: expand batching to background routes only; added KV-cache pilot next cycle.

2025-03-03 - KV cache experiment launched on beta customers (2 customers). Observed hit-rate variance by prompt family; spike in cold-start errors required a fallback tweak. Filed engineering task ENG-20110 for cache warm-up job.

2025-03-15 - Quantization experiment matrix finalized. Selected 3 models for 8-bit eval and 1 model for 4-bit synthetic trials. Research provided fidelity thresholds and hallucination regressions to monitor.

2025-03-25 - Milestone: first cross-sectional report drafted and shared with Executive Review. Preliminary projected savings: 9-16% net unit-cost for combined changes if quality targets met. Shared report: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COST/Experimentation+Hub

2025-03-28 - Action: move two successful batching policies to rollout-canary; gating automation ticket created for automated rollback on quality regressions. Assigned to ENG-ops team for rollout automation.
milestones: M1: Baseline collection and experiment matrix approved - 2025-01-24
M2: Batching v2 canary deployed to 10% traffic on background routes - 2025-02-20
M3: KV/prefix cache pilot on beta customers - 2025-03-03
M4: Quantization fidelity gate evaluations complete - 2025-04-15
M5: Consolidated savings playbook and Optimize integration - 2025-06-30
metrics: Primary OKR: reduce hosted per-token inference cost by 15% (net) across standard text-gen flows by 2025-Q3
Latency SLA: maintain median latency within +10% of baseline for production routes
Quality guardrail: no more than 1.5% increase in user-facing semantic regressions as measured by prompt-set evals
Experiment signal: KV hit-rate > 35% and quantized BLEU/ROUGE decline < defined fidelity thresholds
risks: Quality regression from aggressive quantization leading to customer-visible hallucinations
Batching increases tail latency for bursty interactive routes if mis-routed
KV cache warm-up introduces cache-thrashing on low-reuse traffic patterns
Operational burden: rollouts without automated rollback increase incident risk
decisions: Scope batching rollout to non-interactive/background routes first (approved 2025-02-18)
Require automated fidelity gating for any quantization promotion to production (decision on 2025-03-15)
KV pilot to include explicit warm-up job before steady-state traffic (action assigned to ENG-ops)
asks: Engineering: 4 engineer-weeks for rollout automation and cache warm-up job (requested from infra squad)
Research: include a small prompt-set (100 prompts) per customer to track semantic regressions for quant trials
Customer Success: opt-in beta customers for KV pilot and provide post-change feedback
